article.title: Ogun rep joins APC
article.text: The member representing Ogun Demo Constituency 1 in the House of Representatives, Hon. Wale Ogunleye-Banjo, has joined the All Progressives Congress. Ogunleye-Banjo, who was elected on the platform of the Peoples Democratic Party, said on Monday: "I have formally joined the APC today and I urge my supporters to follow me."
